Text: WHEN the POS sends a completed purchase event, the loyalty service shall create a pending points transaction for the member.
The loyalty service shall award 1 point per SGD 1 of the purchase amount after voucher discounts, rounded down per transaction.
Rationale: Earning rule in the programme terms v3; points are not earned on the discounted part.

Text: The loyalty service shall award double points on the member's birthday.
Rationale: Dropped from the launch scope by SH-01 on 2026-10-20.

Text: IF a member returns a purchase within 24 hours, THEN the loyalty service shall reverse the pending points transaction of that purchase.
